spec.strategy: equal-weight NIFTY50, monthly rebalance, as-of membership
spec.decision_rule: 00:15 IST on the month's first observed session
spec.benchmark: official NIFTY50 TRI via benchmark_total_return (T+1 joins)
spec.fee_policy: full-notional round-trip per name per month (conservative upper bound); gross-only before 2026-03-01
spec.attribution: Membership: Jha, A. (2026). NSE Historical Membership (Point-in-Time). github.com/aditya-jha/nse-historical-membership. Derived from public NSE Indices Limited press releases and NSE Exchange circulars. CC BY 4.0.

labels.retrospective: backtest over archived official records — not a forward prediction
labels.survivorship: none — membership is as-of at every decision; SURVIVOR_BIASED must not be claimed
labels.benchmark_relative: strategy-minus-TRI is excess vs benchmark; NEVER display as cash profit

panel.membership_attribution: Membership: Jha, A. (2026). NSE Historical Membership (Point-in-Time). github.com/aditya-jha/nse-historical-membership. Derived from public NSE Indices Limited press releases and NSE Exchange circulars. CC BY 4.0.

default_run.excess_claim: v3_benchmark_relative semantics — excess vs benchmark, never cash profit
default_run.net_note: net chained ONLY over months whose entry falls on/after 2026-03-01 (fee truth); earlier months are gross-only with charges_status=SCHEDULE_UNAVAILABLE_BEFORE_EFFECTIVE_DATE

action_discontinuities.policy: windows are REPORTED, never dropped (dropping would bias upward); no factor is imputed; adjustment status stays UNKNOWN until a verified corporate-actions source is ingested
action_discontinuities.consequence: the strategy-vs-TRI comparison is NOT economically interpretable: TRI assumes action-adjusted holding, the strategy holds raw unadjusted prices
